interpretation: Cosine retrieval; no global data normalization is learned. StandardScaler is fitted inside each classifier training fold. High batch predictability suggests a shortcut, not proof of artifact.
study_note: JUMP pilot processed CellProfiler profiles from two plates. The batch field is plate identity, not distinct experimental batches. First 128 shared alphabetical features; controls and nonfinite wells excluded. Published preprocessing may use controls across the source batch. Held-out-compound plate classification is a diagnostic, not proof of biological artifacts.
